principles: Prefer exact path allowlists over broad directory exemptions
Lifecycle artifact policy text and executable registry must stay aligned
Scope gates should fail closed for unrecognized generated evidence
The repair should preserve existing proof-admissibility and DONE semantics
drivers: Observed B-ce03 DONE flow blocked on a generated live-smoke transcript artifact
The artifact is command-generated lifecycle evidence for the same story
Opening all evidence paths would weaken scope control

options.name: A: Add exact live-smoke transcript lifecycle artifact path
pros: Fixes the observed generated-artifact false positive
Preserves fail-closed handling for arbitrary sibling evidence files
cons: Requires keeping one more registry/doc/test entry synchronized

options.name: B: Whitelist the whole evidence directory
cons: Could hide arbitrary story metadata or accidental evidence drift

options.name: C: Leave classifier unchanged and require scope acknowledgement
cons: TEST/DONE users hit an impossible or misleading acknowledgement path
Generated first-party lifecycle evidence remains blocked

chosen: A: Add exact live-smoke transcript lifecycle artifact path
rationale: Option A fixes the real gate false positive while preserving the closed registry safety model; broad directory allowlisting would trade speed for weaker scope proof.

preMortem.trigger: Implementation uses a prefix or directory wildcard instead of an exact relative path
preMortem.consequence: Scope gate stops detecting unrelated generated evidence drift
preMortem.mitigation: Add negative regression for evidence/notes.md and keep registry exact-path only

preMortem.scenario: Documentation says live-smoke is allowed but verifier registry omits it
preMortem.consequence: DONE continues to block on live-smoke transcript artifact
preMortem.mitigation: Run scope-contract smoke and process fact contract verifier

preMortem.trigger: Classifier ignores storyId ownership when matching lifecycle artifact paths
preMortem.consequence: One story can smuggle another story artifact through scope gates
preMortem.mitigation: Keep same-story path classification path and do not alter storyId matching semantics
